build_map_categorical_mlp: build an MLP that encodes a categorical function of a single variable f(x) using input and output vector spaces
create_map_categorical_to_numerical_mlp: create an MLP to compute f(x) from a categorical input to a numerical output using a lookup table
build_sequence_map_categorical_mlp: build an MLP that encodes a categorical function of two variables f(x, y) with logical-and hidden layer
review_map_categorical_mlp: review the map_categorical_mlp function that returns an MLP for single-variable categorical transformations
review_sequence_map_categorical_mlp: review the sequence_map_categorical_mlp function that returns an MLP for two-variable categorical transformations
